title: Lay out a KG subgraph with Graphviz (the Form Documentor's convention)
description: Projects a subgraph of the knowledge graph (today: an iHRIS product's forms, from the committed data model and module records) and writes it as Graphviz DOT in the convention of i2ce 4.3.3's Form Documentor (I2CE_Page_FormDocumentor::dot): Mrecord table nodes with required (*) and unique (!) marks, fill from the first matching substring:colour of the product's scheme, else ivory3; MAP fields with several targets through a splitter point; child forms in firebrick; i2ce's graph options. The site lays it out in the browser with Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly (@hpcc-js/wasm-graphviz 1.6.1, src/site/kg-graph.js: unflatten -l 2 -f -c 2 | dot), with pan, zoom, find and draggable nodes whose edges follow.

inputs.name: modules
inputs.description: Read from src/<package>/modules/4.3.3/ (child forms, the Form Documentor colour scheme and graph options)

outputs.name: subgraphLayout
outputs.description: DOT on stdout or --out; the site writes data-model/graph/<product>.dot
